_comment: Configuration for `pnpm bench:jess:ab` — see bench/jess/ab.ts. This is the PARSEMAN axis of jess grammar tracking: the same four shipping grammars, HEAD against a pinned parseman release. The complementary jess-side axis lives in the jess repo at scripts/bench-compare-ref.mjs and moves the GRAMMAR while holding parseman still.
_referenceNote: v0.50.2, the PREVIOUS RELEASE. Both sides are built from THIS repo and the timing mode uses a separate matching self-control, so nothing machine-specific is stored and the comparison re-derives itself on whatever box runs it. Bump this to the merged released sha at every release, in the release PR, quoting the numbers read in that PR. Do NOT bump it to silence a red gate: moving the reference forward onto a slower build launders the regression into the baseline and destroys the record for everyone after.
_refEngineNote: Both 0.50.2 and HEAD lower the shipping macro to static table assembly. ab.ts detects and prints each realised lowering and source path; the macro release gate rejects any other pairing.

measurement._note: ONE parse per repetition (targetSampleMs 0 disables calibration): these fixtures are 100 KB+, so a single parse is already a sample of useful size and the reported millisecond IS one parse. Deliberately identical to `M` in bench/jess/fixture.ts so a figure from the two harnesses differs by the LEGS and by nothing else.
